facts.claim: 次日清晨她在 Luke 家醒来时，他已起床在厨房弄出声响，咖啡香把她引出卧室。
facts.quote: and making noise in the kitchen. The smell of coffee drew me out of bed

facts.claim: 她在客厅扫视满屋运动器材（滑雪板、击剑服、蹦床等），假意称赞“真了不起”。
facts.quote: This is impressive” I lied, sweeping my arm over all the equipment.

facts.claim: 他果然照做：屈膝发力，把她整个人抱进怀里，再抱回卧室。
facts.quote: He did exactly that, reader—bending at the knees to engage his core

facts.claim: 躺在床上时 Luke 透露，Dan 每次见面都缠着要私下见 Austin Gregory。
facts.quote: Guy keeps asking if he can see Austin Gregory

facts.claim: 她回想起 Dan 说过 Gregory 夫妇是他最不想见的人，自问他为何至少在 Austin 的事上撒谎。
facts.quote: So why had he lied, at least where Austin Gregory was concerned?

facts.claim: Luke 从零开始现做华夫饼，她意识到自己不是一般的喜欢他，而是“真的喜欢上”了。
facts.quote: It was official: I didn’t just like him. I like liked him.

facts.claim: 她在西侧崖边发现一块巨石上系着一条垂下悬崖的绳子，想到这正是攀爬潜入的现成工具。
facts.quote: tie a rope around one of the boulders and dangle said rope over the cliff

facts.claim: 她当即给 Kay 发短信称发现重大线索，要她尽快赶来，并注明无人有危险。
facts.quote: Found something HUGE; come ASAP. (No one in danger.)

relations.rel: 决定认真交往、不再当作一夜情的恋人
relations.quote: I would not treat him like a mere one-night stand.

relations.rel: Dan 一心想“私下”见他，要 Luke 偷偷把人放进去
relations.quote: Off the record. Wants me to slip him in.”

relations.rel: 共同办案的搭档，Dan 那番话是两人一起听到的
relations.quote: What he’d said to me and Kay earlier in the day came back to me now

relations.rel: 声称他们是自己世上最不想见的人，与私下求见 Austin 自相矛盾
relations.quote: They’re the last two people on earth I’d ever want to meet.

relations.rel: 推断她用在监狱练就的攀岩本事攀绳潜入 Sweet Spot
relations.quote: Deirdre Gregory, who had honed her rock-climbing skills while in prison

relations.rel: Genevieve 把 Sweet Spot 建成隔绝外界的堡垒，如今却被渗透
relations.quote: Genevieve Caraway had built to protect herself from the outside world.

numbers.claim: 她把睡过头归因于进化留下的“倦怠”化学反应（数百万年的进化）
numbers.quote: millions of years’ worth of evolution kicking in

numbers.claim: 她调侃 Luke 的回答音节数终于上到“两位数”，说明沟通有进步
numbers.quote: I was getting syllable counts in the double digits here with these responses.

numbers.claim: 靠墙放着两副滑雪板、一块单板与一块桨板
numbers.quote: two pairs of skis, a snowboard, and a paddleboard

numbers.claim: Dan 至少三四次提出要见 Austin Gregory
她父亲在八十年代末买了初代 BowFlex 健身器
numbers.quote: My father had gotten one of the original BowFlex machines in the late eighties

numbers.claim: 西侧崖边有一排巨石，共六块，是建房时挖出堆在一侧的
numbers.quote: Near the edge was a series of boulders, six in total.

numbers.claim: 他深吸一口气，胸口抬高了数英寸才开口
numbers.quote: He took a deep breath before answering me, his chest rising a few inches

numbers.claim: 她明确不把 Luke 当成一夜情对象
numbers.quote: I would not treat him like a mere one-night stand.

numbers.claim: 查了一整天，两人仍未弄清 Deirdre 如何潜入
numbers.quote: any closer to solving after a day’s worth of investigating

numbers.claim: 她说除了一件拒绝去想的“例外”，从未与男人有过这般身体默契
numbers.quote: Because with one exception—an exception I refused to dwell on

turning_point: 她在 Sweet Spot 西侧崖边发现一条系在巨石上、垂下悬崖的绳子，断定 Deirdre Gregory 正是攀绳潜入，且必有内应帮忙——案情由此破口，而她说自己已确信内应是谁。
notes: 结尾只说“确信是谁”却未点名，内应身份留待下一章；“one exception”具体所指本章未交代；Deirdre 投宿 La Dorada 与 Swole Squad 在该处聚会是否巧合，仅为主观揣测，未证实。
